# mtncloud_tenant (Data Source)

Master tenant only: customer (sub-tenant) logins get 403 from the API it uses. Looks up a tenant by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_tenant" "example_tenant" {
  name = "Demo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud tenant.

### Read-Only

- `account_name` (String) An optional field that can be used for billing and accounting
- `account_number` (String) An optional field that can be used for billing and accounting
- `customer_number` (String) An optional field that can be used for billing and accounting
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
